title: Shadow Warrior 2
prepared_input_summary: Action sequel using guns, blades, magic and humor against demons.
relevant_profile_signals: Direct active combat, mastery and clear progression are strong positives.
Shared/co-op play is a strong enhancer when cooperation is meaningful.
Sequels are preferred when they noticeably evolve the formula rather than simply repeat it.

retrieval_actions.query_or_request: "Shadow Warrior 2" official gameplay weapons skills procedural co-op 324800
retrieval_actions.source_page_identity: Steam store page, app 324800, Shadow Warrior 2
retrieval_actions.factual_evidence_obtained: The sequel adds four-player campaign co-op, procedurally generated environments, primary/side missions, weapon/armor/relic loot, multiple melee and firearm types, situational damage systems, and a custom weapon-upgrade system.

decision_basis: The sequel visibly evolves the combat formula with co-op, broader weapons, customization and mission/environment variation while retaining the active sword/gun combat that strongly matches the profile. Procedural repetition is a caveat, so confidence remains medium rather than high.
